leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open and the balance is positive in every branch of the recommended plan, provided the redundant offer is pulled before the raise is placed. Placed in the wrong order the balance goes slightly negative when that offer settles overnight — three days clear of the lock and trivially undone by the sale, but there is no reason to create it. The rule that overrides everything still stands: a negative balance at matchday start scores nothing for the whole matchday, and spending is capped by the floor rather than by cash, which is not close to binding here.

binding_gap: The binding constraint has moved. It was the empty squad slot and the penalty attached to it; that is closed. What binds now is the sequence and the cash it consumes: the pending offer on a player who is no longer needed is what caps the raise on the player who is, so the removal has to happen before the raise. Behind that, the structural gap is midfield and attack rather than defence — every remaining body worth holding is holding up a formation, and defenders past the fifth cannot enter the eleven however much they cost.

verdict.headline: Both morning bids landed.
verdict.detail: Both morning bids landed. ter Horst arrived first, Amoako settled mid-run, and the squad crossed the eleven-player threshold for the first time in five runs — the minus-hundred penalty that has led every briefing this week is cleared. Three formations now fill. The run is no longer about survival; it is about the order in which four actions are taken, because doing them in the wrong sequence opens a negative balance. Remove the Krattenmacher offer, then raise the Maluze bid, then accept the standing offer on Sylla, then sell Bernardo after tonight's deadline. The Maluze raise is the one with a clock on it, resolving inside the hour.

sell.reason: Sylla is the sale to execute today and it is finally legal at this squad size, in both branches of the pending bid. Take the manager offer rather than dumping to Kickbase — one of the two standing offers sits above market value, so the better route costs nothing extra. The Schalke reporting dated today has him as the club's most probable departure to raise transfer income, with no concrete bid yet, and it makes the point that matters: the decision need not fall on deadline day, because the Turkish window runs to the fourth and the Saudi to the sixth. The deletion risk therefore survives past the lock, not just past tonight. Selling costs a handful of points off the fielded eleven and nothing else. Bernardo is the second sale, deferred rather than cancelled, to the gap between tonight's deadline and the evening repricing — held until then purely as insurance against a deadline-day deletion elsewhere in the squad, and gated on Maluze landing first. Lokonga and Widmer are both demoted from funding sales to holds; they are the structure holding the formation up.

standing.name: Sylla
standing.why: REPLACES S916gx2 and S5qflbn (both closed, both carried stale prices and a shape gate that has now OPENED). THE SALE IS LEGAL AS OF NOW: squad 12 = 1GK/5DEF/3MID/3ATT, selling Sylla gives 1/5/3/2 = 5-3-2. If Maluze also lands it is 13 -> 12 = 1/6/3/2, also 5-3-2. Both branches legal, so the gate that blocked every previous run is gone. TAKE THE MANAGER OFFER, DO NOT DUMP TO KICKBASE: Georg's own listing (dt 2026-09-01T09:24:08Z) carries TWO live offers - David 9.230.000 and reafix 9.225.516. David's is 4.484 above mv 9.225.516, so accepting David beats the Kickbase dump the old calls recommended. Small money, but free. NEWS, dated today: schalketotal.de 01.09.2026 "Weitere Neuzugaenge? Sylla-Abgang? So plant Schalke den Deadline Day" - Sylla named the most probable departure to raise the transfer income Schalke need, CEO Tillmann has rejected the 3M floor as "not sufficient", no concrete bid reported yet, and crucially the piece states a decision "does not necessarily have to fall on deadline day" because TURKEY runs to 04.09 and SAUDI ARABIA to 06.09. THAT IS THE POINT THAT CHANGES THE URGENCY CALCULUS: the Turkish window closes 2026-09-04, the same day MD2 locks at 18:30Z, so the deletion risk runs right up to and through the lock and does NOT end at tonight's 18:00Z German deadline. Sell now rather than reasoning about windows again in six hours. COST IS 21 ap AND NOTHING ELSE: with Sylla the XI is 5-2-3 for 1313 ap; without him 5-3-2 for 1292 ap, Amoako replacing him at 0. Twenty-one points to bank 9.230.000 and retire a risk that would otherwise land as a forced squad change at Kickbase's timing rather than Georg's. Fit, started MD1, ap 21 - the worst scorer in the squad. He is already on the BLOCKED list, no new block needed.

standing.name: Bernardo

TWO GATES, both mandatory: (1) the Sylla sale must already be done, and (2) the squad must still be 12 AFTER that sale - i.e. Maluze must have landed. At 12 the sale gives 11 = 1GK/5DEF/3MID/2ATT = 5-3-2, legal. If Maluze is LOST, the post-Sylla squad is 11 and selling Bernardo makes it 10 = -100. Do not sell in that branch. WHY DEFER RATHER THAN SELL NOW: the 6h between now and 18:00Z is exactly the window in which a deadline-day departure can delete a squad member - Amoako (HSV fringe, 0 starts) is the live exposure - and an 11-man squad has no margin for that. Holding Bernardo as the 12th body through the window is free insurance against a -100. Selling before the 20:00Z tick then captures today's mv before the st=2 flag feeds into tonight's repricing. THE FLAG IS REAL AND NEW-ISH: get_player 1954 returns st=2, stl=[2], stxt "Stricken - does not come through KOE (A) unscathed", status timestamp 2026-08-31T14:40:12Z. He picked up a knock at Koeln on MD1 - that is why he was hooked at 53 minutes, an injury substitution rather than the Hranac demotion an earlier run assumed. Treat him as DOUBTFUL for MD2, not ruled out. DATE TRAP, still live: the "Bernardo faellt verletzungsbedingt im TSG-Kader" item and the TSG tweet naming a Bayern away XI are 08.02.2026, LAST SEASON. Hoffenheim's MD2 is at home to DORTMUND on 2026-09-05T13:30Z. COST OF THE SALE: 33 ap - the XI swaps Bernardo 62 for Widmer 29 - against 6.712.365 banked and a ~605k/day bleed (sdmvt -605.383) stopped.

buy.reason: Maluze is the only buy worth making and the bid is already live — it needs raising, not replacing. He started the opening match, played it out, signed an extension to twenty-thirty-one the same week, carries no flag and is absent from the injury table. His points return against his market value is the best of anything in squad or board by a wide margin, and it stays the best even after the recommended raise. The board added nothing else: the freshest listing is a midfielder who cost his owner points on the opening day at a price near twenty million, and the recognisable name at exactly market value prices out at several times what Georg has been paying per point. Three manager asks were repriced overnight and all three remain refusals. One measured lesson worth carrying: a manager ask cleared well under where it was posted for the second time in a day, which confirms these asks are negotiable and belong in the low cluster.

standing.name: Maluze
standing.why: RAISE the live 3.600.000 offer to 5.500.000 before ~11:52Z. HARD PRECONDITION, do this first or the balance goes negative: REMOVE the Krattenmacher offer (or accept the Sylla sale) BEFORE raising. Arithmetic - cash 7.377.522, Krattenmacher 2.000.000 still committed, so a 5.500.000 Maluze bid on top is MINUS 122.478. Remove Krattenmacher and the ceiling is 5.377.522; sell Sylla too (+9.230.000) and it is 14.607.522. VERIFIED CLEAN THIS RUN, dated: Ligainsider profile - marked Fit, no injury or suspension flag, NOT on the Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table (swept 2026-09-01); 1 appearance, 1 START, 95 of 96 minutes in 2026/27; 29.08.2026 "SGE-Talent Maluze: Neuer Vertrag zum Bundesliga-Debuet" - contract extended to 2031 the same week he debuted, which is the club telling you he is in the plans; 21.08.2026 "Maluze steht erstmals auf dem Platz". get_player confirms st=0, stl empty, sec 6161 (full match), 1 yellow. At the current 3.600.000 that is 18,6k PER POINT; even at 5.500.000 it is 28,4k/pt, still the best points-per-euro anywhere in squad or board - Georg just paid 68k/pt for ter Horst and 79,18% over mv for Amoako who has scored NOTHING. Kickbase board listing, so benchmark the HIGH cluster: the measured record is Nguefack +135,52% and our live 3.600.000 is already +152,63%, but the percentage band is computed off cheap no-name bodies and does not price a genuine ap-194 starter. Ljubicic cleared +27,34% (7.918.127 on mv 6.218.127) at 08:51Z today for ap 43 - 184k/pt - which is what rivals in this league will pay for mediocrity; Maluze is visible to all 18 of them and mv is climbing fast (tfhmvt +498.205 in 24h, mvt 1), so today's mv understates him and tonight's 20:00Z tick will reprice him upward. HONEST DOWNSIDE: Kickbase is pay-your-bid, not second-price, so if nobody else bids the raise wastes 1.900.000. Accepted deliberately - losing ap 194 costs more than 1,9M, and every row in the calibration table is a loss from bidding too low (Nguefack lost three times, cleared at +80,16% above our best bid). Frankfurt play MD2 on 2026-09-06T15:30Z v Augsburg, comfortably inside the MD2 window. NOTE for a future run: at ap 194 Maluze is a live candidate to top MD2 and trigger the league MVP forced-sale rule - that is fine, he would sell at a much higher mv and Georg keeps the MD2 points.
